title: 玻尿酸洗面奶 - 创意款
selling_points: 玻尿酸深层清洁，锁水保湿
专为油敏肌，温和不刺激

shots.visual_description: A person skeptically looking at a 'dry skin after wash' meme, then confidently washing their face, revealing skin as smooth and glowing as a freshly peeled egg.
shots.narration: 谁说清洁就得牺牲保湿？我用它洗出“水润剥了壳的鸡蛋”！
shots.rationale: [反常识型开场] 挑战传统认知，用夸张的比喻颠覆“洗脸会干”的观念，突出产品清洁补水兼顾的独特优势。

shots.visual_description: A person with slightly oily, dull skin looking exasperated in front of a bathroom mirror, dramatically wiping their face with a towel. The lighting is harsh, emphasizing skin imperfections. Comical close-up on their face, showing frustration.
shots.narration: 以前洗完脸，不是紧绷到裂开，就是油光满面。感觉皮肤要“散架”了。
shots.rationale: 通过夸张的画面和自嘲式文案，展现传统清洁的痛点，引出产品“清洁补水，平衡兼顾”的必要性。

shots.visual_description: A dynamic, energetic transition effect. A quick, smooth wipe or zoom across the screen, revealing a bright, clean, and refreshing aesthetic. A shimmering light effect accompanies the transition.
shots.narration: 直到我遇到了它，简直是“洗脸界的救星”！
shots.rationale: 作为承上启下的过渡，制造期待感，将观众的注意力从痛点引向即将出现的产品。

shots.visual_description: A close-up shot of the hyaluronic acid cleanser bottle, elegantly designed, glowing softly against a minimalist, bright bathroom background. Gentle light highlights the product's texture and branding. Focus on the 'Hyaluronic Acid' label.
shots.narration: 就是这款玻尿酸洗面奶，看清楚了，是“玻尿酸”！
shots.rationale: 特写展示产品，强调核心成分玻尿酸，为后续“玻尿酸深层清洁，锁水保湿”的卖点做铺垫。

shots.visual_description: Close-up of hands gently squeezing the cleanser onto a palm, revealing a rich, pearlescent texture. The hands then lather it into a soft, luxurious foam, glistening under warm, inviting light. The foam appears dense and creamy.
shots.narration: 挤出来是水润质地，轻轻一搓，泡泡绵密得像云朵。
shots.rationale: 展示产品质地和起泡效果，通过“像云朵”的比喻，突出其“温和不刺激”的特点。

shots.visual_description: An extreme close-up of a person's face after cleansing, with skin looking incredibly smooth, plump, and glowing, almost like a cartoonish 'peeled egg'. A humorous, exaggerated sparkle effect around the face. The person looks astonished and delighted.
shots.narration: 洗完脸，真的像“剥了壳的鸡蛋”，水润到能反光！
shots.rationale: 夸张地展现清洁后的水润效果，呼应开场Hook，强调“清洁补水，平衡兼顾”的卖点。

shots.visual_description: The cleanser bottle is positioned prominently, with subtle animated graphics of hyaluronic acid molecules gently penetrating a stylized skin layer around it. Soft, scientific-inspired lighting illuminates the scene, emphasizing the deep action.
shots.narration: 玻尿酸深入毛孔，脏东西被带走，水分却牢牢锁住。
shots.rationale: 再次特写产品，通过视觉元素和文案，解释“玻尿酸深层清洁，锁水保湿”的科学原理。

shots.visual_description: A close-up of hands gently massaging the cleanser onto a face, focusing on the delicate touch, especially around sensitive areas. The skin looks calm and comfortable during the process, under soft, natural lighting. Emphasize the gentle lather.
shots.narration: 我是油敏肌，用它完全不刺激，敏感肌也能安心用。
shots.rationale: 展示实际使用感受，直接点出“专为油敏肌，温和不刺激”的核心卖点，增加信任感。

shots.visual_description: A confident person smiling brightly, showing off their radiant, balanced skin in a well-lit, fresh environment. Their skin appears perfectly clear, neither oily nor dry. A subtle, natural glow around their face, conveying health and happiness.
shots.narration: 清洁力强，保湿力也在线，这才是洗面奶的“天花板”！
shots.rationale: 总结性地展示最终效果，强化“清洁补水，平衡兼顾”的整体优势，提升产品吸引力。

shots.visual_description: A confident creator, with visibly radiant and fresh skin, holds the玻尿酸洗面奶, looking directly at the camera with a triumphant smile. The background is bright and clean, emphasizing purity. Creator slightly gestures with the product, reinforcing its effectiveness and the claim made in the hook.
shots.narration: 所以，谁说清洁就得牺牲保湿？看，我用事实告诉你，清洁和保湿，真的可以完美兼顾！
shots.rationale: 直接回答了开场Hook的疑问句“谁说清洁就得牺牲保湿？”，通过创作者的亲身示范和产品，给出明确的否定答案和解决方案，形成有力的首尾呼应。

shots.visual_description: Extreme close-up on the creator's face, showcasing incredibly smooth, dewy, and reflective skin, resembling a 'peeled egg'. Soft, flattering lighting highlights the skin's texture, emphasizing its hydration. A subtle, natural glow effect enhances the look, followed by a quick text overlay: '水润剥了壳的鸡蛋肌' for visual reinforcement.
shots.narration: 想要拥有我这种洗完水润到能反光的“剥了壳的鸡蛋肌”吗？别再让你的肌肤将就了！
shots.rationale: 视觉上再次强化了开场Hook和主体内容中提到的“水润剥了壳的鸡蛋”这一核心效果，通过提问式口播引导观众思考并产生渴望，为后续的行动号召做铺垫。

shots.visual_description: The玻尿酸洗面奶 product is prominently displayed, perhaps rotating or with a shimmering effect. A clear, animated '立即购买' (Buy Now) button or a shopping cart icon appears, along with a '关注我' (Follow Me) prompt. Creator's hand might enter the frame to point emphatically towards the CTA, creating a dynamic visual.
shots.narration: 你的肌肤蜕变刻不容缓！点击下方小黄车，立即入手这款玻尿酸洗面奶，告别紧绷油腻，即刻解锁水润奇迹！
shots.rationale: 提供明确、有力量感和紧迫感的行动号召（CTA），引导用户购买或关注。其中“告别紧绷油腻”呼应了主体内容中描述的痛点，强化了产品带来的解决方案，完成视频的转化目标。

structure_preview: 开场: 创作者自嘲式分享“油敏肌”的痛苦经历，夸张描述皮肤问题。
